The official results pages for the elections of this year show no Wichita mayoral contest. Wichita elects its mayor at-large to a four-year term, and mayoral elections fell in 2011, 2015, 2019 and 2023. The next mayoral election falls in 2027.

The decisive general election is recorded in wichita_results.json. The City Council page states that the mayor is elected at-large and that terms are four years.
